review_description: Installed by MC Electrical in Eagle Farm, Brisbane.Having had my 10kW solar panels and Tesla battery installed in July, I wanted to evaluate their performance over time before providing an honest review. With a technical background, I conducted extensive research on solar solutions before making my decision. After several months of ownership, I am extremely satisfied with the product, as I write this review from my air-conditioned room, which incurs no running costs.The entire process, from the informative sales experience with Nicole to the installation and post-installation support, has been exceptional. Nicole demonstrated extensive product knowledge and presented a variety of options, ultimately guiding me to select a 9.7 kW array with a Tesla Powerwall 3 Battery, all without any sales pressure.Communication with the company, facilitated by Joanna, was thorough and left no room for uncertainty. On installation day, Alan and the team executed the project seamlessly, reflecting their excellent training and coordination. This was a key reason for choosing this company; they employ their own tradesmen and apprentices, ensuring cohesive teamwork. The installation was meticulous, with cable runs perfectly aligned with the house's aesthetic, making them nearly invisible.In summary, my choice was based on several factors:- The company is solid and well-established, a testament to Mark Cavanagh's leadership and commitment to employee training.- The product is first-class, with all components tested firsthand at the MC Electrical site.- The staff were professional and efficient.- The pricing was competitive and justified.I highly recommend this company for their honest and reliable service. Well done!  Ray Chapel Hill

From the first quote through to installation, the team at MC Electrical were fantastic. The initial quote went through all of the details, pros and cons of each brand, ran through all of the options so that we were able to make an informed decision.  Between quote and installation there was a site visit by an electrician to make sure everything was accounted for and that nothing had been missed prior to installation.  Installation day went smoothly, the team arrived on time, and completed the works with no issues. After sales support has been fantastic for any questions we have had and the system has been running perfectly since installation.

Seemless and professional experience from quoting through installation and post install communication.  MC have set the bar for customer service in any industry.I look at solar as an investment in not just the hardware and installation, but the ongoing relationship and support.  Given the experience to date I am very confident that MC will assist for the years to come.Exceptional work!

MC electrical have been fantastic throughout the entire process, from quote to after sales service. The price quoted was equal to or better than other providers for a higher quality system. The communication throughout has been amazing, even though the install was subject to significant delays on my end due to the construction of our house being delayed. The installers were friendly, polite, knowledgeable, and helpful, and the installation is high quality. In fact, most of our new distribution board was reconfigured so that they could fit everything required in neatly (at no additional cost to us). Overall, MC Electrical have fitted in with our needs and delivered a high-quality system and service. I recommend MC Electrical to anyone seeking a solar system.

We generate way more than we need on an average sunny day and the setup is easy to use.   I now have a 1st world problem of trying to get the best price for excess energy I don't use after my battery is full.   Thanks to the team at MC Electrical for such a brilliant experience and installation.  Installation was complex but the team did it efficiently and professionally and no mess.   Quality of workmanship is also reflected in the professionalism they showed during time onsite…and they left no mess.

-Had a BYD battery installed to a existing system by another company.-Quoting smooth and not pushy. Very knowledgeable.-Day of install, great communication from the electricians. Some delays in the delivery of parts but didn't cause any trouble on our part.  they stayed late to get the job done that day. overall very impressed.-They followed up afterwards to check if there were any issues and are going to send out to fix a small issue with the previously installed catch relay for free which I think is great customer service.Overall very happy with the experience. Compared to the company who did the initial solar (which were still very good) I would say they are much better and would recommend them to anyone needing Solar/batteries installed.
MC Electrical are a great company to deal with. From the quoting,  to the installation process they were great people to work with.

We had purchasing solar on our bucket list for the house since we purchased it about 8 years ago. The idea of purchasing solar was always a daunting one, learning about the tech, the cost and of course trusting a supplier / installer.So when the time had come to finally tick solar of the "to do" list we used Solar Quotes to look for reputable installers in our local area. We received three quotes, one of which was MC Electrical who we ended up going with. From the very beginning we found the process of working with MC Electrical to be excellent. The whole team just worked, Nicole, our solar consultant, was personable, direct and incredibly knowledgeable.Bek in admin was always helpful over the phone and helped guide us through the process leading up to install. Install day came and the team was incredible. From the guys on the roof to Josh and Lawrence on the ground, the install was carried out professionally, respectfully and neatly (probably the first time I have ever seen sparkies clean up). They made sure the batten screen was structurally sound prior to battery install before Alan came and worked his magic and hooked the battery up.They provided an overview of the work carried out and shut down procedures in case any issues arise.We would not hesitate to recommend MC Electrical for anyone looking at installing solar.

MC Electrical were brilliant from end-to-end. They were communicative, courteous, prompt, treated my home with respect, and had a high degree of work ethic and workmanship. They are very busy installers in Brisbane, and I can see why. But they're worth the wait!In comparison to 3 other installers that I interacted with, MC Electrical stood out as being calm and quietly confident in their offering, without any upsell, misinformation, or false urgency. They treated me like an engineer and so pitched their information at the right level. I had already played around with a system layout in Pylon, and worked together with their solar designer to tweak and optimise it, which was fun. Their final price was competitive, they were able to squeeze me into their schedule early, and they were considerate of the finer details. For example, their racking system is made locally in Brisbane, and had well designed feet for my old Queenslander's roof.Huge thanks to the whole team. Now my home is nuclear powered (from a safe distance)!

I just want to take the time to praise MC Electrical for their efforts from start to finish. From working with Jason to design the perfect solar and battery system for me all the way through to Adam and the team for the seamless installation and commissioning process. The crew was always on time and happy to answer any questions I had. The installation looks perfect with attention to detail at the highest level. Thanks again.

MC Electrical were really accommodating throughout the delayed handover process of our new house, adjusting the install date on multiple occasions without complaint. The installation team were very knowledgeable and friendly, and did their best to work around our needs on the day. After installation we were followed up to make sure that everything met our expectations. Overall, we're really happy with the service we received and the system installed, and would happily recommend MC Electrical to others looking to have a solar system supplied and installed.
The whole process from making an enquiry to install has been really smooth. Great customer service on the phone and onsite.

Sales/quoting process was easy and helpful as we went through numerous scenarios.Installation day the guys were clean very informative and efficient polite, informing me how to use the system fully. I would highly recommend using them.

I asked lots of questions pre install and during. Installers took the time to answer my questions which were simple clarifications, nothing scary. Preinstall communication was excellent again answering my myriad of questions. Nothing was too difficult in terms of product delivery and follow up service.Installers were on time, professional and cleaned the work site post install. Post install inspection wasn’t rushed. Very happy.

Great team and service from first contact, through site visit, quote, finance options, responding to questions. And then a seamless installation by a polite, tidy, friendly and professional crew. We are very happy!

These installers turned up on time, and the sales process was very clear and efficient. They were professional, courteous and kept us informed of everything along the way. Also very flexible when we had an issue with our insurer. Would highly recommend.

The team installed the conduit cleanly and professionally, and took the time to explain the system and features clearly afterwards.The panels and clip lock mounting look professionally done, and the inverter placement was well considered for future battery installation and car charging.
Great service from quoting right through to installation. They were knowledgeable, punctual, professional and friendly.

From the initial contact right the way through to the installation I am unable to fault MC Electrical. The lady that came and quoted was very knowledgeable and there was no pressure sales tactics. It was obvious that the products on offer are quality and no cheap options. Therefore expect to be paying more than the cheap companies however i was happy to pay for quality brands and installation. The team that did the removal and install of my solar system were a great bunch of guys. Excellent attention to detail and respectful. The system is running great and i know if i have any issues i have access to them for support. A+++

I had to reschedule quite a few times due to various roofing issues. Was no issue for MC Electrical which handled moving the date around fine. The day before they let me know what was happening and how it would happen which was great. On the day the trades people all got to work and did a fantastic job with the install taking their time to do it right. Overall very pleased with their entire process and the quality of work done.
Great company from sales through to installation team and office admin. Everything went perfectly according to the plan. I would highly recommend MC Electrical.

There hasn’t been anything we can fault in the entire process. The quotation meeting the quotation presentation and the professionalism and honesty of the advice the speed and quality of the installation, the clean site post installation the speed and communication from the support team at every step in the process is astounding and should be a benchmark of business practices,We cannot recommend MC highly enough and strongly recommended that they be considered if you are looking for peace of mind cost effective solar system installation.

MC Electrical are a highly professional company installing solar and batteries. They are greatly informative and the process was flawless at every step of the journey. They are honest and upfront and thier response time is impeccable. They handled all of the grid connections and informed on the process at every stage so you felt confident that you were being taken care of. All of their staff are friendly and happy to answer any questions with patience and humility. I would recommend MC Electrical to anyone in SE QLD looking to install a solar and battery system.

My home lost hot water recently and it became obvious that the Fronius Solar Relay was not operating correctly. As an aside the Solar Web App on my phone had not worked for some time.I contacted MC Electrical to help as they had originally installed the the system in 2017 and I was extremely pleased with  their performance on that job. The price was right, the staff were courteous, friendly and polite and they did not damage my Decromastic roof which I was concerned about.The MC Electrical staff arrived at my home on time and got to work on the problem. With the relay connecting correctly the electrician logged into the inverter and checked all of the Hot Water parameters for my system. He also looked at why my Solar Web app wasn't working.but could not fix it on site so he referred it to the MC office.During the following 2 days I had a number of phone calls and text messages from the office regarding the app leading to it being fixed.The whole experience illustrated to me how great customer outcomes occur when people act professionally and as a team.

Sales staff member advising had experience of actually installing systems. Had an appreciation of my site's issues.My existing system was 12 years old and I wanted to increase its capacity. Due to changed regulations and standards, the easiest approach was to replace the system.My previous installer had disappeared over 10 years ago. Didn't feel any pressure during the sales process. In fact it was over before I committed to replacing the system.Documentation was good about the timeline. Installers were quiet and professional in their activities and manner.Could I have negotiated a better deal with another supplier? Don't know! This supplier has good web presence. All the employees appear to be positive and believe in the product.Technical details have been supplied to me. Do I understand them? Not completely but they are patiently explaining them to me when I ask.Connection to the grid was easy as there was already solar to the premises. However they adjusted the tariffs with the provider.We will review the situation in six months to see whether a battery should be added.

MC Electrical are very professional in all they do and the sales team was very helpful in explaining their system. Communication from the team was excellent and timely and the installation was completed like clockwork with clear explanations on the day including a good handover. It was obvious this team knew their jobs and the new system was working on the day. Grid connection has also been organised and overall we are very happy with the service and installation.

These guys are the real deal. They have been around for ages and are real experts in solar, unlike many of their competitors.Every person I dealt with was polite and professional and knew what they were doing. Everything was well communicated and I'm very happy with the installation overall.
Great team to work with. Replaced an aging 2 kW system with a modern setup and EV charger, all in a single day. Great communication throughout. Highly recommended.

Excellent communication and customer service.Punctual and hard working crew. Very polite ,helpful and efficient .Solar panel blend in really well with the roof and I am extremely happy with the over all service. Would be happy to recommend this company. Thank you.

MC electrical helped me make an informed decision based on all the cutting edge technology available at the time of install. Installers were very kind and knew their stuff.  Very tidy and high quality job and happy with the result. They monitor the system after install. I went with them after a referral by a friend. Very impressed.

Had a great experience with MC Electrical. From quote to installation the company and their personnel have been faultless. The great reviews they get are not by chance and would highly recommend them.

Fantastic experience from start to finish, happy with all communications and quality of work, trades were always on time and pleasant to deal with. Happy to recommend them to all my friends and family.
Polite and professional team of installers, service customer ready and courteous to assist, electricians clear to explain the system

MC Electrical did an awesome job installing our solar system. From the start, they were super professional, easy to deal with, and really knew their stuff. The whole team was friendly and respectful, and the workmanship was spot-on — everything looks great and works perfectly.The process was smooth from beginning to end, and we always felt like we were in good hands. It’s clear they take pride in their work and genuinely care about their customers.Would definitely recommend them to anyone thinking about going solar!
The whole process from initial contact to completion was fantastic. Never was lost during the whole process. The install was very professional. Have already recommended!
This review is regarding a recent solar battery system which was retro fitted fitted to our existing 10kw solar system. MC Electrical & Solar have carried out all works

The information provided by MCElectrical was relevant and helpful. The installers were friendly, punctual, professional, conscientious and clean. The customer service has been prompt and supportive throughout the process. We heartily recommend MCElectrical.

The quoting was an easy and detailed process. This is my second install from MC Electrical. The installion of 36 panels, an EV charger, extra 15 amp socket, extra fuses to allow for more air conditioners later and a T3 powerwall was done in one day by a professional team. The place was left very tidy with no rubbish left on site. The system was powering my house and charging the battery before they left.

I would highly recommend MC Electrical to install new solar panels. I also feel confident knowing that MC Electrical only deal with reliable suppliers and that the panels and inverter are top quality. I wouldn't hesitate to use them again or refer friends and family to them.

From start to finish MC Electrical were fantastic. Every staff member we worked with from Nicole in sales, to Alan and the team who installed the solar equipment to Bek and Jo in the office was very kind, thorough and professional. Nicole was even kind enough to help us sort out a roof issue while she was on leave over the Christmas break. We never expected that level of service but it really made our day. Everything followed their project timeline perfectly. All staff arrived when they said would and their after-sales service has been second to none, so I definitely would recommend the MC Electrical team to anybody looking for a solar installer. Thanks again :)

We recently had MC Solar and Electrical install our solar system, and we couldn’t be happier with the entire experience! From start to finish, the team was professional, efficient, and clearly dedicated to delivering top-quality service.A special shoutout to Josh, the electrician, who was absolutely fantastic. He was personable, knowledgeable, and meticulous in his work, ensuring that every detail was handled with care. How can one explain the process of working with MC Electrical the install of everything solar. First of all, go to the MC Electrical web site, everything needed to make informed decisions, and not afraid to call out the unprofessional side of the Solar Industry.By not putting them at the top of your list in installing solar, you would be doing yourself a great disservice.I originally had my roof top solar panels installed by MC ElectricalL last year and was so impressed with the sales and service, the professional workmanship of the employees (not subcontractors) that I decided to expand my Fronius system with a BYD Battery.After 1 day, I am convinced I made the right decision as my house ran all night on battery power and by midday the following day, battery was fully charged and the house was running on Solar with no power coming from the grid and also a small amount feeding back to the grid. How good is that, very small bill to come next month.MC Electrical may not be the dollar value that people are looking for however, quality and workmanship rate highly with me and that is why I chose MC Electrical
From quote to installation through to follow up, every technician and customer service contact was polite, helpful and incredibly efficient. I would 100% recommend this company to everyone I know.

MC Electrical have made the whole solar journey a pleasurable experience. The team were very knowledgeable and kept us informed throughout the whole process which made it very enjoyable. The installers did a fantastic job, cleaned up after themselves and were more than happy to answer any questions that we had about the installation and maintenance of the solar system. On completion of the installation the office staff have been very diligent about ensuring that we are up and running and connected back to the grid. I would recommend MC Electrical to anyone that is thinking about getting solar connected to their home.
Professional and informative throughout quote, inspection and installation.Good value for high quality products and workmanship.

I got a few quotes for my solar system. MC Electrical was not the cheapest, but by far the most professional and after looking at numerous reviews and interaction with different companies - I felt confident that MC Electrical was the best choice to go with.With the installation, they were on time, very professional in their work and dealings with us throughout the day.After installation they assisted very well with all transitions and follow-up actions.Friendly and very help-some team.5 Stars

Had an amazing experience with MC Electrical from the quotation stage through to installation. Mark B was very patient with all my questions during the initial stage and same with Brady S and team during installation. Even Jo from Accounts Team has been very helpful with all my queries. All were very professional, polite and friendly. It’s too early to leave a review for both the solar panels and inverter performance but so far so good! Happy with my decision to go with MC Electrical. Highly recommended!

I was a little hesitant at first to have MC visit before providing a quote, but it is absolutely the right move. Nicole came out and showed me about their products and answered all of my questions. I really like that they have their own "lab" to test their products and the effects of different scenarios on efficiency. These guys are more than just a reseller.The install lead time was a little long (about 2 months) but the customer service along the way was excellent. The installers did an amazing job as well they checked my home circuits during the switch board upgrade and even fixed a faulty ground on a light setting at no charge.Day of the solar Install was so smooth. They showed up with 4 guys and just got it done. It only took about 6 - 7 hours for a 13 kW system. I'm not an expert, but the quality of the workmanship looks great.They are a premium service and won't be the cheapest quote you get, but I would still highly recommend MC for your solar needs.
This is the 2nd time we have had MC Electrical install our Solar Panels. Both times they have been awesome! So friendly, approachable, professional and we highly recommend!

The customer service experience was excellent, never had issues getting in touch with anyone who could answer my questions. Sales and quotes were efficient and easy, never felt pushed or harassed unlike many other companies. They provided a high-quality system with a price that was comparable to other quotes I received for objectively cheaper or lesser capacity parts (465w panels instead of 440w, Fronius inverter instead of Sungrow/others).They also accommodated installing a self supplied EV charger as well as a 'PV Point' from the fronius inverter to provide some limited blackout protection, all within the paid price.The install crew were always on-time, never complained once, and it was clear over the course of the install day that they spent plenty of time ensuring a proper and clean installation. Even caught one of the installers roaming the property late in the day checking for rogue trash, A++.Could not recommend them enough. Being one of the top rated installers in the SE QLD area i expected to pay a premium, and that was not the case. It is clear from spending a few minutes on their website that they are selling solar the way it should be sold. This is more than just a solar installation company, and they are trying to set the standard for doing it right, doing it well, and want to continue to evolve and keep up with all the industry standards, best practices and best products.

After initial conversation with Mark at the main office, providing his knowledge of solar systems and batteries then Ben in the sales team helped us make decisions on what was the right setup for updating our energy requirements, we made the decision to install our energy system through Mc Electrical.Then Joanna who organised the installation team and keeping updated was well communicated.On the day of installation Shaun and his team arrived on time and answered all our questions thoroughly throughout the installation process.We were more than happy with our experience with Mc Electrical and would recommend them to anyone thinking on installing a solar and battery systemMany thanksPeter

After moving to a new property and realising the solar need updating I knew I'd be contacting MC Electrical.This is the second time I've used them for a solar install, they're just excellent at what they do.Stand out points include advice during quotation, no pushy sales approach, answering questions and guidance as to battery viability (not for me this time but never say never), communication from the office and the polite & considerate install team.I've recommended MC Electrical a few times (based on my previous install) and won't hesitate to again. They make your solar install as plug-and-play as you could need.Thanks team.

Thanks to all the crew at MC Electrical for our new solar system.  We chose you based on the positive reviews and feedback and it's a pleasure to add to those!  Thanks for making the process as easy as possible, installing quality products, completing a professional instillation and continued top support from your" people".  We're VERY pleased with our product - so thanks!!

Every step of the process was extremely well done. Quotes were comprehensive and communication was ever present and professional. The install itself was half a day and I was shown how to operate the inventory on completion. I can now monitor my system via phone and desktop for real-time information on my new solar panels. Overall, very happy.

How was the sales/quoting process:The sales process was quick and smooth, I was greet and ran threw some preliminary questions before speaking to the solar consultant, this was to help the consultation go smoothly. Once done I had a quote in a day!How did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual:The install was the best, this company goes above and beyond. They send out an electrician who goes through and makes sure everything will run smoothly on the day. The next day they made sure all the access was provisioned and stepped me through it.10/10 on every level and was so impressed, especially when they were the highest rated and ended up being the cheapest of 3 quotes.

After some minor communication issues at the beginning, the team at MC Electrical did a fantastic instillation that was very professional. They managed to identify a few problems with our home and quickly managed to find solutions to these issues and were excellent to work with and paid meticulous attention to detail. They even did a fantastic job of cleaning up after themselves. I could not recommend MC Electrical more.

People SAY a lot of things.MC Electrical:- confirm appointments- take the time to understand your needs- provide great advice and a fair quote- call back when they say they will- always turn up on time- are friendly- install quality equipment, and leave the site clean and tidy- ensure all is working well (even my legacy monitoring device!)- follow up to check on the systemWhat people DO is more important than what people say.Thank you to Lauren, Jo, Jason, Brady, Kendall and anyone else involved with our recent installation. Highly recommended!
Very satisfied with the process from initial enquiries to final installation. MC Electrical staff were professional and extremely helpful throughout. Excellent in all aspects.

MC Electrical are the most professional company I've dealt with. I originally went with this company 7 years ago when we had a 6.5KW panels and Fronius installed. They knew exactly what to recommend for my situation and they have a team that is fabulous. From the quoting stage, to the install and the admin, everyone knows their job and are a pleasure to deal with. I didn't think twice when I decided to install the Tesla Powerwall 3 and got Yorick around to quote on the install. As soon as the Powerwall were released in Australia then the install team came and installed it for me. They did an outstanding job on the install and extremely neat and correct. I cannot recommend these guys highly enough. Do not be fooled by the cheap fly by night companies that will install an inferior product and nowhere near the high standard of MCE.

I’ve just received my extended solar system, 10 years since my first faultless installation by the MC Electrical team.  The first system has performed faultlessly, which is a testament to the quality of their work.My new system was a real test joining an older Tesla/solaredge setup. The team was awesome seamlessly integrating my new Fronius  My garage wall is an artwork of electrical engineering, outstanding.  The professionalism from the first interaction to the delivery of the new system and follow-up is fantastic.  Having over 10 years with the company, I have always felt supported able to pick up a phone and find a friendly interaction  nothing seems to hard.Rock Stars

From quotation to installation MC Solar were great to deal with, very neat , efficient  and helpful all throughout,  cleaned up on completion and a fair price.  Looking forward to seeing how everything performs in the future,  would certainly recommend MC Solar.

The whole process with everyone i dealt with great. The installers turned up on time and they finished when they said the would. The guys were very polite, neat and tidy workers and kept me up date as the day went on. Very happy with everyone involved...highly recommended

Every interaction with MC Electrical, from quoting, the office support team, the pre-inspection, through to the install; was seamless.The sales/quotation was open, transparent and all made sense.We were so impressed with the whole install team. Everything was explained and every care was taken.Our site wasn't easy, but that didn't seem to daunt the installers. We were replacing an old system, and MC Electrical took care of the removal and recycling of the components.The team were professional and courteous and the site was left spotless.

I was researching and fact checking other quotes and constantly found the MC Electrical YouTube site.  So that's the starting point. They really are interesting in the technology and systems that go into a solar install. All the way down to the racking product.They back the Catch relay product hot and more importantly integrate the  3 phase 6 channel power monitoring using CT clamps and a full knowledge of the options for power monitoring.  Full import export data independent of the retailers reporting and through a simple API that can be connected to an home assistant server  to help manage power usage.  No smart meter upgrade required.2 tradies and 3 apprentices on site to install 26 kw of panels and a 20kw  symo inverter. 2 day install with everyone professional and in good spirits.MC Electrical was the only company out of 6 quotes to provide a full range of quotes with correct specifications etc etc.  But more importantly the only company to sit down at my kitchen table and listen to everything I said, work through the complex shade situation and then put together what I requested, but also what they thought was the best combination of systems to match my needs.All at a competitive price but still using premium components for every part of the build, wiring, connectors, racking, tech screws.

Recommended by a friend, MC Solar has delivered on a perfect solution for my needs, in a very professional manner. The guys who installed it were courteous but friendly and informative. Really impressed by them. The customer service since installation has been great, and the monitoring app lets me see when and how I’m using the generated power. Definitely will recommend to anyone who asks me about solar. Thanks guys!

Really good experience from when I contacted MC Electrical to when the system was installed. I had a fair idea of what we wanted which helped to narrow down the options.  The guys were super easy to deal with and were happy to explain anything I wasn't sure of.  Install was smooth and no dramas.  Much appreciated the professional approach.  Thank you!

MC Electrical installed our solar system...the whole end to end process is excellent.  The products are high quality, the people are nice and the installation workmanship is excellent, and pre/post sales service is great. Thank you !!

MC Electrical installed our solar system and batteries, which took approximately three days. The system has been a game changer. We have a 40 kWh battery and 13.2 kw system. I noticed them because my export values were out of the ordinary or my inverter stopped producing energy and need to be manually restarted.My case hasn't be resolved till today and my last email from late April hasn't be responded to.
